scope: Named native-to-extension driver dispatch entries across all bundled drivers, GenericRequest routes, LoaderWin32 control calls, and statically named reverse calls to the native host. Internal helper functions are excluded.

semantics.sourcePresence: A registered dispatch entry in the inspected bundle, not a guarantee that it works on every page or in every runtime.
semantics.requestFields: Direct parameter property accesses found in each handler, accounting for shadowed function bindings. They are not a complete required/optional parameter schema; helper functions can access additional fields.
semantics.emptyRequestFields: No direct fields were extracted; this does not establish that the operation takes no arguments.
semantics.genericRouting: A special handler takes precedence over g_callMapping. contentCommandId is an internal ID, not the native messageId.
semantics.descriptions: General Vietnamese summaries based on handler bodies, field access and command names; they are not a published UiPath API contract.
